description: This file contains implementations of sharded tensor initialization operations such as uniform, normal, kaiming_uniform, and constant, along with tensor creation functions for distributed sharded tensors in PyTorch.

methods.name: validate_param
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is None and raises ValueError if so.

methods.name: uniform_
methods.description: Fills a sharded tensor with values from a uniform distribution.

methods.name: normal_
methods.description: Fills a sharded tensor with values from a normal distribution.

methods.name: kaiming_uniform_
methods.description: Initializes a sharded tensor with Kaiming uniform distribution.

methods.name: constant_
methods.description: Fills a sharded tensor with a constant value.

methods.name: register_tensor_creation_op
methods.description: Registers tensor creation operations for sharded tensors.
